meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面截图比对,判定视觉是否跑版并给出结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都得靠肉眼确认有没有跑版
copy.tagline_en: Screenshot-compare web and terminal UIs, then deliver a verdict on whether they look right
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every UI change still needs a human eyeballing it for breakage

howto.what: 构建或改动界面后，Claude 会截图取证，跑脚本做比图和终端宽度检查，再派两个只读审查员并行复核，最后给出 PASS／REVISE／FAIL 结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动任何界面、准备宣布完成时，或需要核对 mock／基线、怀疑回归、担心 CJK 文字截断时触发。没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑则跳过。

say.text: 帮我给这个新页面做 visual QA，给出结论
say.note: 它会截图、比图并派两名审查员复核

say.text: 这个终端 TUI 有没有溢出或边框错位？
say.note: 它用 xterm.js 截图并做宽度检查

say.text: 这份 40 页 PDF 每页都截图核对了吗？
say.note: 它会逐页渲染成图，不抽样

howto.what_en: After a UI build or change, Claude captures screenshots, runs diff and terminal-width checks, dispatches two read-only reviewer passes, and returns one PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict per page.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change a UI — web pages, terminal TUIs, paginated docs — or to check a mock, baseline, or CJK clipping. Skipped when nothing renders.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this new page and give me a verdict.
say_en.note: It captures, diffs, and sends two reviewers.

say_en.text: Does this TUI overflow or break its borders?
say_en.note: It screenshots via xterm.js and runs a width check.

say_en.text: Did you screenshot all 40 PDF pages, not a sample?
say_en.note: It renders every page to an image.
